scope: Actual frozen DotIgnoreIgnoreRule.CheckIgnoreRules and ShouldIgnore/ClearDirectoryCache over real files, plus the bound .NET Regex runtime's BMP case equivalences, Unicode categories and block data. Rules include full paths, separators, directories, comment/empty/invalid handling, ordered negation, globstars, character classes/subtraction, category/block escapes, case/hex escapes, Unicode boundaries, octal escapes and backreferences. Sequential actual BitFaster FastConcurrentLru operations also cover configured capacities, warm-up, eviction, updates, removal and clear. Files cover nearest ancestor selection, directory start, cached absence/parent results, timestamp/length invalidation, deletion/clear and UTF-8/16/32 BOM decoding. Does not execute native FindExtras/scanning, symlinks, network failure paths, concurrent access, all .NET regex syntax, HTTP/WS or release acceptance.
candidateComparison: All 67 rule groups (263 checks), 24 native real-file groups and five actual sequential TU-Q groups (2298 operations, complete entries and queue counts) are compared by the production rule compiler, VFS ignore cache and native cache policy. The candidate uses Memory VFS only as a fixture backend with a declared known ancestor namespace. Unmapped ancestors remain incomplete. The comparison also checks sealed runtime character facts; it does not prove FindExtras/scanner integration, network, symlinks, concurrent native access, every CLR regex construct or release acceptance.
